description.value: Askew's Foods Uptown is a locally owned independent supermarket with roots going back to 1929, part of a four-store family-run chain serving the Shuswap-Thompson-Okanagan region. The Uptown Salmon Arm location is a full-service store with dedicated pharmacy, deli, bakery, meat, produce, and floral departments — a well-stocked resupply option for touring cyclists passing through town. The company emphasizes sourcing from local farmers and suppliers, reflecting a strong community-oriented tradition maintained across four generations of the Askew family.

address.value: 2701 11th Ave NE, Salmon Arm, BC V1E 2S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at askewsfoods.com/uptown-sa confirms the store is open and operating, with a full staff roster, address (2701 11th Ave NE, Salmon Arm, BC V1E 2S3), and phone (250) 832-7622 — neither of which appear in the OSM tags. Basic groceries is confirmed true from the OSM shop=supermarket tag and the website's depiction of a full-service independent supermarket with deli, bakery, produce, meat, and pharmacy departments. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null per absence-of-evidence rules.
